Charming and expansive single-family home with original moldings, wood baseboards, classic doors, and a decorative fireplace. This unique 1,840+ square foot residence spans two floors of functional living space over a large attached garage, positioned on quiet residential block in highly-coveted Sunset/Parkside area. Enjoy serene, park-like views across street through living-room windows and no houses directly opposite for maximum privacy. Ocean views from upper-level bedrooms on clear days.
MAIN FLOOR (UPPER LEVEL):
-- Grand Living & Dining Rooms: Features stunning cathedral-ceiling living room, decorative fireplace, and balcony. Formal dining room connects to a central patio.
-- Gourmet Kitchen: With top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, solid surface countertops, updated lighting, windows overlooking patio, and a skylight.
-- Sun-Lit Breakfast Room / Den / Workspace: Between dining room and kitchen, this versatile room overlooks the central patio and features custom built-ins and elegant arched display niches.
-- Bedrooms & Bath: Two spacious, symmetrical windowed bedrooms with garden and ocean views; full bathroom with skylight, separate tub and shower with mid-century details.
GROUND FLOOR (LOWER LEVEL):
-- Massive Ensuite Bedroom & Bath: Looks out to large, tree-lined backyard and lawn.
-- Flexible Interior Bedroom / Home Office: Adjacent to the large ensuite bedroom, this enclosed room could function as a quiet nursery, media room, home office, or private wellness studio.
-- Mudroom/Storage Gallery: Coming off the garage, this large area has newly-finished epoxy-coated floors.
-- Dedicated Laundry Space: With top-of-the-line full-sized washer and dryer.
-- 1-car garage: With ample storage space.
OUTDOOR SPACES:
-- A classic central patio lightwell provides natural lighting throughout the day.
-- Large backyard with mature trees and a fire pit with sitting area.
-- Front lawn with planted succulents.
LOCATION & COMMUTE ADVANTAGES:
Steps from the #66 bus stop at the corner and just 2 blocks from the Muni L-line. Easy access to the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco International Airport (SFO). Simple commute to Financial District, Daly City and the South Bay. Short walk to Pine Lake Park.
RENTAL TERMS & CRITERIA:
-- Showings: Please submit an initial inquiry to arrange a viewing. To help coordinate scheduling, please include a brief introduction with your intended household size, reason for moving, and current tenancy length.
-- Lease Terms: Standard one-year lease with option to renew/extend. One-month security deposit.
-- Screening Criteria: Credit check required (720+ FICO score preferred) alongside comprehensive employment and income verification (gross monthly household income of 3x rent preferred).
-- Utilities: Tenant responsible for PG&E, water, trash collection, and internet access.
Smoking Policy: Strictly non-smoking.
-- Pet Policy: A small pet will be considered for an additional monthly pet premium fee.
-- Occupancy Note: Base rent covers up to 3 adult occupants. An additional $250 per month applies for each adult occupant beyond 3.
